title: Invoice fields
description: Eight fields of one invoice, extracted from an email body or a plain-text invoice.

vendor_name.description: The company that issued the invoice (the seller), as written, including its legal suffix.

invoice_number.description: The invoice number exactly as written.

invoice_date.description: The invoice (issue) date as an ISO date.

due_date.description: The payment due date as an ISO date; invoice date + N days for terms such as 'Net 30'; null when absent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the invoice currency.

total_amount.description: Gross total of this invoice including tax, before deducting payments already made.

tax_amount.description: Tax (VAT or sales tax) amount of this invoice; null when not stated.

po_number.description: The buyer's purchase order number exactly as written; null when absent.
